messages:
Keiko Tan: FYI I hit a production crash: SPA tries to JSON.parse a streaming chunk after user presses Back. Error is Unexpected end of JSON input. Looks like partial chunk was handed to the app.

Liam Brooks: is this the multibyte + chunk-split problem? Browser TextDecoder state loss if you call decode per chunk.

Keiko Tan: yup. Our sample app does `decoder.decode(chunk)` per chunk then append. Quick fix is `decoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true})` and only parse after detecting a full SSE event delimiter.

Rina Patel: also saw another customer where auth refresh caused proxy to inject a 401 HTML page mid-stream. Client tried to parse HTML as JSON and crashed. We should detect HTML-ish chunks and surface an AuthError with status/headers instead of parsing.

Liam Brooks: suggested SDK changes: (1) use streaming TextDecoder in browser SDK, (2) maintain leftover bytes and only JSON.parse complete frames (split on normalized `\n\n`), (3) emit `stream_incomplete` with base64 leftover on abort/close, (4) surface final status + headers when non-200 body appears mid-stream, and (5) default `autoRetryStreaming: 'none'` with optional resume token API.

Keiko Tan: for SPA guidance add a short snippet for AbortController + window.onpopstate to cancel streams on navigation so users don't get partial closes. Also update quickstart sample.

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-2301 "browser-sample: handle partial chunks, auth mid-stream, and streaming retry policy" and assigned Keiko, Liam, Rina.

Liam Brooks: I'll draft the SDK PR with tests for partial UTF-8 (emoji/CJK), HTML mid-stream detection, and stream_incomplete diag event. ETA end of week.

Rina Patel: QA will add an integration that backgrounds the tab, triggers auth refresh mid-stream, and verifies `stream_incomplete` + AuthError are emitted.

Keiko Tan: perfect. I'll update the sample and add a tiny repro gist to the ticket. If anyone needs a quick workaround before the SDK patch: use streaming TextDecoder, normalize CRLF, and buffer until `\n\n` before parsing.
